snippet.title: Thank You Bus Driver - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5067360/Thank_You_Bus_Driver/

Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.

Don't forget to wishlist it now and be ready on launch day, October 14!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5067360/Thank_You_Bus_Driver/
GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/thank_you_bus_driver
Humble Store: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/thank-you-bus-driver
itch: https://doublefine.itch.io/thank-you-bus-driver
Epic: https://store.epicgames.com/p/thank-you-bus-driver-2e64a6
